text:
maria: Heads up — nightly perf CI is noisy again. 3/5 traces show different kernel timelines and the diff dashboard is flagging regressions :eyes:
jon: Which kernels are moving around? can you paste perf-bot output?
akshay: Usually two things: nsys sampling mode can perturb the schedule, and GPU power/clock state causes run-to-run variance. also our KV-cache warmup isn't consistent in the CI job.
maria: perf-bot output (trimmed):
```
perf-bot: nightly-perf 1837654321: 2/6 traces exceeded regression threshold. main deltas: cublasGemm (+8-13% tail), attention_kv_update (+10-18% on some runs). overall token throughput regressed ~6% in worse runs.
```
maria: Current nsys wrapper we run in CI: 
```
nsys profile --output $OUT --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --capture-range=cudaLaunch:cudaDeviceSynchronize --stats true --force-overwrite --wait=ms
# outputs: $OUT.qdrep, $OUT.sqlite
```
lina: Can we switch to non-sampling detailed trace (trace-only) and narrow capture-range to model inference window? sampling+long capture tends to change kernel overlap. Also run a short deterministic run without profiler to get baseline numbers.
jon: Another knob — pin GPU clocks at start of job: `nvidia-smi -pm 1 && nvidia-smi -lgc 1200,1200` (runner must have permissions). small warmup runs to populate KV cache too.
akshay: Also we should collect provenance per-artifact: git sha, model name, batch size, seed, GPU model, driver. stash those next to the trace so diffs can be filtered by env.
maria: Proposed CI change (snippet):
```
# jobs: nightly-perf
- run: |
    nvidia-smi -pm 1 || true
    nvidia-smi -lgc 1200,1200 || true
    ./ci/warmup_kv_cache.sh --model $MODEL --iters 3
    # deterministic baseline (no profiler)
    CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 ./bin/infer --batch $BATCH --seed 42 > baseline.json
    # traced profiles (narrow capture + trace-only)
    nsys profile --output perf-${CI_JOB_ID} --trace=cuda,nvtx --capture-range=kernel:start:kernel:end --force-overwrite ./bin/infer --batch $BATCH
    tar -czf perf-${CI_JOB_ID}.tgz perf-${CI_JOB_ID}.* baseline.json provenance.json
    aws s3 cp perf-${CI_JOB_ID}.tgz s3://redwood-perf/ci-traces/nightly/${CI_JOB_ID}/
```
jon: perf-bot: artifact upload confirmed for recent run?
perf-bot: nightly-perf job 1837654321 completed, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/ci-traces/nightly/1837654321/ — 2/6 traces failed threshold, see UI.
maria: Action items: (1) flip CI to trace-only nsys flags + tighten capture-range (2) add pre-warmup for KV cache (3) pin GPU clocks in runner (4) include provenance.json in artifacts (git sha, model, config) (5) add a deterministic micro-benchmark run to anchor diffs. I'll open the PR today and tag @akshay and @lina.
jon: Also: tweak diff dashboard to ignore tiny ops (<2% of total token time) and add a checkbox to compare only deterministic-baseline vs profiled-run. reduces noise.
maria: Great — putting together PR now. thanks all :thumbsup:
